## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue, if any.

## Validation

List commands run and results. Separate offline checks, native compilation and
simulator qualification; state anything not tested and why.

Dependency updates that affect Siemens adapters or native harnesses also need
their affected native builds and qualification; hosted offline checks cannot
approve that compatibility.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation reflect the change.
- [ ] Support claims match the recorded target and evidence.
- [ ] No credentials, customer project data, generated output or Siemens binaries are included.
